# Clear English Quiz (https://clearenglishquiz.com/)

> Learn English. Test Yourself. Grow with Confidence.

Clear English Quiz is a free, interactive English-learning platform designed for global English language learners (CEFR A2, B1, B2, and C1). It provides self-contained grammar quizzes, vocabulary tests, business English practice, and comprehensive learning guides with clear, step-by-step explanations for every single question.

## Core Learning Categories
- [All Quizzes](https://clearenglishquiz.com/quizzes/): Complete index of English grammar and vocabulary quizzes.
- [English Grammar Quizzes](https://clearenglishquiz.com/english-grammar-quizzes/): Tenses, prepositions, articles, conditionals, and common mistakes.
- [English Vocabulary Tests](https://clearenglishquiz.com/english-vocabulary-tests/): Essential vocabulary, idioms, and high-frequency phrasal verbs.
- [English Level Practice](https://clearenglishquiz.com/english-level-practice/): Practice organized by CEFR levels (A2, B1, B2).
- [Business English](https://clearenglishquiz.com/business-english/): Workplace vocabulary, emails, meetings, and professional correspondence.
- [English Learning Guides](https://clearenglishquiz.com/english-learning-guides/): Educational articles with grammar rules, common learner errors, and clear usage examples.
- [Free AI Quiz Generator](https://clearenglishquiz.com/ai-quiz-generator/): Instant custom quiz and grammar explanations generator for any topic.

## Key Quizzes
- [Present Perfect vs. Past Simple](https://clearenglishquiz.com/english-grammar-quizzes/present-perfect-vs-past-simple/): Practice distinguishing completed past actions with definite times from actions connected to the present.
- [English Prepositions Test (in, on, at)](https://clearenglishquiz.com/english-grammar-quizzes/english-prepositions-test/): Master prepositions of time, place, and location.
- [English Articles (a, an, the)](https://clearenglishquiz.com/english-grammar-quizzes/english-articles-a-an-the/): Practice definite vs. indefinite articles and zero article rules.
- [English Conditionals](https://clearenglishquiz.com/english-grammar-quizzes/english-conditionals-quiz/): Zero, first, second, and third conditional structures.
- [Common English Mistakes](https://clearenglishquiz.com/english-grammar-quizzes/english-common-mistakes-quiz/): Subject-verb agreement, confusing word pairs, and word order.
- [A2 Vocabulary Quiz](https://clearenglishquiz.com/english-vocabulary-tests/a2-english-vocabulary-quiz/): Everyday English expressions and high-frequency vocabulary.
- [Phrasal Verbs Test](https://clearenglishquiz.com/english-vocabulary-tests/phrasal-verbs-test/): Practical phrasal verbs used in casual and workplace contexts.
- [B1 Intermediate Grammar Test](https://clearenglishquiz.com/english-level-practice/b1-english-grammar-test/): Intermediate tenses, modals, and comparative structures.
- [B2 Upper-Intermediate Practice](https://clearenglishquiz.com/english-level-practice/b2-english-grammar-practice/): Advanced conjunctions, subjunctive mood, and complex inversion.
- [Business English Vocabulary](https://clearenglishquiz.com/business-english/business-english-vocabulary-test/): Professional communication, meetings, and workplace terminology.
